title: Suppression of Terrorist Activities Special Courts Amendment Act 1987

sections.shortTitle: Suppression of Terrorist Activities Special Courts Amendment Act 1987
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IX OF 1987
SUPPRESSION OF
TERRORIST ACTIVITIES
(SPECIAL COURTS)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1987
ACT IX OF 1987
An Act further to amend the Suppression of Terrorist
Activities (Special Courts) Act, 1975.
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary
Part I, 15th November, 1987]
The following Acts of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the
assent of the President on the 8th November, 1987, and is hereby published for
general information:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called
the Suppression of Terrorist Activities (Special Courts) (Amendment) Act, 1987.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Suppression of Terrorist Activities Special Courts Amendment Act 1987
sections.description:
Amendment of Schedule, Act XV of 1975

ACT IX OF 1987
SUPPRESSION OF
TERRORIST ACTIVITIES
(SPECIAL COURTS)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1987
ACT IX OF 1987
An Act further to amend the Suppression of Terrorist
Activities (Special Courts) Act, 1975.
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary
Part I, 15th November, 1987]
The following Acts of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the
assent of the President on the 8th November, 1987, and is hereby published for
general information:--
2. Amendment of Schedule, Act
XV of 1975.--In the Suppression of Terrorist Activities (Special Courts)
Act, 1975 (XV of 1975), in the Schedule, in paragraph (a), after sub-paragraph
(ii), the following new sub-paragraph shall be inserted, namely:--
"(iia) section 302 or
section 307, if committed in the course .of the same transaction in which an offence
specified in this paragraph or paragraphs (b) and (c) is committed, or in
addition to, or in combination with, such offence;".
